style.title: Pick a style
style.subtitle: Each style improves perception metrics for a specific context
style.framingLocked: Your photo doesn't show the torso — this framing is locked. Upload a photo where shoulders and torso are visible.
style.framingLockedUnknown: We couldn't determine the photo composition — only portrait framing is available.
style.framingManualHintHalf: For the best result, upload a photo where the shoulders and torso are visible.
style.framingManualHintFull: For the best result, upload a full-length photo or at least one showing the legs to the knee.
style.compositionFaceCloseup: Only the face is visible in the photo — body generation may produce unnatural proportions. Portrait styles are available.
style.compositionUnknown: We couldn't determine the photo composition — only portrait styles are available.
style.styleLockedComposition: This style needs a photo with shoulders and torso visible.
style.styleRiskyComposition: This style expects a visible torso — on a tight face crop the result may be unstable.
